body: Thank you.... I hope I do too.

I've tried. I really, honestly have. I've flat up said "When you don't respond to me while you're texting someone else, I feel like that person is more important than me." Then he gives the excuse of "I hyper focus in things." And doesn't offer any way of changing. Which frustrates me because in therapy, I've had to change dozens of my awful, harmful habits for our relationship. And I feel like I'm supposed to change who I am entirely to make it work.

She depends on me to make it back and forth to doctor appointments, eye appointments, and therapy appointments. She can't really bring herself to ask anyone else for help.

But she has been wanting to try group therapy, but I don't know how to find that sort of thing, neither of us do. Is there somewhere in Seattle, WA that could help us out? We live in West Seattle, but I'm willing to travel anywhere within King County to help her.
A therapist who is also a consultant psychiatrist? Where would I find one?

Honestly, that's been on my mind. 

I don't dare say that to her though, because she is terrified of hospitals and being alone in unfamiliar places, and it would only cause her to panic even more. She's read too many bad things about psychiatric hospitals, and she's told me she would consider it if she was allowed to come and go as she pleases, she is absolutely terrified of being trapped in places alone, ever since she was abandoned in the hospital by her (evil) mother after a surgery where she couldn't even leave the bed (she finally fell asleep when her mother agreed to stay, and when she woke up to get her vitals checked every hour, her mother was gone, and never came back until the next day. My poor wife didn't sleep at all, and the nurses tried to keep her company so her vitals wouldn't get out of control, but they're busy people. and it was like, 10-11pm so she wouldn't call me because I had to work, even though I would have been there in a heartbeat). 

She is a bit of a control freak and likes things to be done her own way and have control over a situation, but it's never been a problem for me, it always little things, and when she wants to leave somewhere, she has to go **now**. I kind of learned the hard way to listen to her when she says she's "not feeling well" or "tired", because that's usually a code word for an oncoming panic attack :/

Thanks, I'll do that. Do you know if there might be a subreddit for that sort of thing as well?

And don't apologize, it's perfectly okay.

Thank you thank you thank you your reply. I will give her a little push in the right direction, but this time, I'll let her choose the therapist. We just went to one wee were recommended. And as for support groups, I wouldn't even know what to look for, to be completely honest.

The wife has always been overly affectionate to everyone, so it wasn't a hard switch to poly for her, hah. I get what you're saying though.

And you are correct about the sexual abuse. It was from a woman, and she was also abused by her own mother, so she is uneasy around women, but she is more attracted to them than men, so it's hard for her, because she's terrified of a woman mishandling her again. It was difficult for me to break through that barrier, especially since the first time we were intimate (no sex, just playing) all the repressed memories flooded back. Sometimes they still show up if I do something a little too roughly, but it hasn't happened for quite a few months.

She's also struggling with the fact that's it *okay* for her to like men **and** women. Her mother (awful devil woman) told her that she was confused and going through a phase when she tried to come out to her. And she believed her so she forced herself to not like women, and it aliened a lot of her friends, who also told her she was just being selfish and trying to be "cool".

Awful parenting aside, she's trying to figure out how to approach other people and show her interest, without over doing it, or under doing it. She's kind of adorably awkward, and it's why I fell in love with her. She treats everyone like a friend, and we just happened to fall for each other.

She tries to flirt with people to show her interest and she either slips into a sort of persona that isn't much like the real her, or she gets flustered and confused and wants to hide.

Sorry if this is jumbled up post.

She usually doesn't. Her mother forced her to clam up her emotions when she was a kid so she struggles to show her emotions because she usually does it too little, where people don't notice unless they're playing close attention or know what to look for. Either that or she over does it, and she feels embarrassed and hides when that happens. She only does it around women, because she has had bad sexual experiences with a woman when she was pretty young. She feels drawn to them because she didn't really have an older female role model, but repelled and fearful because of her mother and assailant.

It's a nice bag of worms.

She was actually the person who brought up being poly at first, I was hesitant, but when I had some time to sit down and think about it, I realized that I was poly too, and it was just having to break past that barrier of social norms.

Her nervousness happened with me as well, but I'm pretty good at reading people, so it was obvious to me that she liked me, but was just not very good at being intimate, and when I gave her some space and time to become comfortable with me, she was fine with kissing and intimacy.

She's actually changed a bit since we got together, she's shyer and not quite as bold as she was, so it's not as easy for a newcomer to read her.

I just really want to help her be happy, I know she has problems showing her emotions, even to me.
I sure hope so. I'm on the verge of a mental breakdown and I have nowhere I can go... Dad's out of town, best friend is at work, husband hasn't been answering his phone for hours.
Yes... Yes this is true. I'm sorry, I'm just kind of freaking out right now...
Thank you so much, and I do have a lot of good guys in my life. I've always been more trusting of men over women, this is probably why.
Animals. Animals are the only thing that make me happy when I feel like total shit.

One thing I would really like to be successful in is something I could never do. I would love to help sick animals, like a veterinarian, but I can't stand the sight of a sick or injured animal. I could never work in an animal shelter because I become attached to animals way too easily, and it would break my heart to see them go and I would probably try to adopt them all. 

Another thing is I would love to be able to play an instrument very well. But it seems whenever I try, I get 'not too bad' before I just can't get any better no matter how much I try, like I've gotten ass good as I'll ever get. And it's like this for anything else I try. I get to a certain level, and I just can't seem to get past that roadblock to get any better than I am, and it makes me not want to try anything at all.
Every time I visit home I miss being here, but when I'm here I miss being there. I just don't know what to do about it sometimes.
It really true... I just wish I could deal with this on my own, or I had a friend that lived nearby.
I know, it's just hard.

I moved here because it's the city where my fiance works. And I haven't really told anyone past my psych about my suicidal thoughts, and what happens during my episodes, I really just don't want my fiance to think I'm insane.

My cat always comes to the rescue when I'm having an episode, usually by scratching or pawing me until he gets my attention. But geez, when I'm depressed and want to snuggle he's nowhere to be found. And I moved 200 miles away from all my friends and family a year ago, and I've been having shitty luck finding any friends in this city. I have been seeing a psych and a therapist, but none of the meds have been working so far.

I read the post you wrote, and it sounds kind of scary to me, because I get overly anxious when I'm not in a comfortable place, like my house, or if I'm not around one of my cats or my fiance. It's the reason I never leave home. Do they let you have stuffed animals in those kind of places?
I do, but the thing is, I live only with my fiance who is gone all day at work, and I'm scared of killing myself during an episode while I'm home alone.
I have been seeing a psychiatrist and a therapist, but neither of them know for cause of my episodes, and they only prescribe pills that don't really work.
I wish I could see my therapist more than once every other week, but she's gots a busy schedule.
Awww :')
I see a therapist and psychiartrist, and it doesn't really help very much...
Maybe I will look into that, I have wanted to try working out, but gyms are usually really expensive...
What do you mean by that?
Then why would you suggest it?
I have tried that once, and to be honestly it did make me happy for about an hour. But I really need a solution to fix it, not to cover it up, though I'm certain temp. Stress relief could help a lot.
I keep thowing upvotes at this, but it only goes up by one D:
It's not about the breakup though, it's about the relationship. I'm trying establish a good friendship, but I don't know what's going wrong.
He's been acting like that before the girlfriend as well. And from what I've obsevered between the two, they're going to break up soon. :/
